data.name: The Housekeeper
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Experience the Weight of a Haunting Memory Step into the shoes of Thedor, a man haunted by a past he can no longer escape. Locked away in a 1900s sanitarium, he recounts the terrifying week that changed his life forever. This is not just a story; it is a confession written in the shadows of a cell.

The Mundane Meets the Unsettling Your job is simple: maintain the order of a prestigious 1900s hotel during the quiet, lonely hours of the night shift. Under the strict, cynical guidance of your supervisor, Mr. K, you must perform your nightly routine. From making beds to scrubbing floors, your tasks keep you grounded—until the heavy silence of the corridors begins to speak back.

A Psychological Descent In this atmospheric horror experience, the terror is not found in what jumps out at you, but in what lingers just out of sight. As you navigate the hotel’s vintage rooms, the presence of Milie—a soul lost to a dark, sacrificial history—begins to manifest. Her influence is subtle, psychological, and relentless. She doesn't just haunt the halls; she haunts your mind.

Key Features:

  • Immersive Psychological Dread: Feel the growing tension of a 1900s night shift where the atmosphere itself is your greatest enemy.

  • Routine-Based Gameplay: Complete mundane chores that contrast sharply with the unfolding paranormal occurrences.

  • Narrative-Driven Experience: Uncover the hotel’s dark secrets through found notes, recordings, and Thedor's own fragmented memories.

  • Authentic 1900s Setting: Explore a meticulously crafted environment inspired by the early 20th century, where every shadow holds a story.

The shift has begun. Will you keep your composure, or will the silence of the hotel consume you?

data.short_description: Work a 1900s night shift where routine chores meet an oppressive psychological dread. As a lone caretaker, navigate the heavy silence and unsettling shadows of a dark past. In this atmospheric horror, the terror lies in what remains unseen. Complete your tasks before the shift takes its toll.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Core i3-4170 or AMD FX-8120
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 or AMD Radeon HD 5850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DX11 Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
